status_summary: A DOL Secretary's memorandum of 2025-06-23 created a temporary Office of Immigration Policy within the Office of the Secretary, focused on employment-based visas and led by the OFLC administrator, which works with ETA on foreign labor certification policy. DOL's undated FY2027 Budget in Brief proposes making OFLC an independent agency separate from ETA, funded at $86.8 million within the Departmental Management appropriation; a law-firm report of 2026-04-13 says it would report to the Deputy Secretary. No enacted appropriation or order moving OFLC out of ETA was found.

timeline.event: A Secretary's memorandum created a temporary Office of Immigration Policy within the Office of the Secretary, focused on employment-based visas and led by the OFLC administrator, with a duty to work with the ETA Assistant Secretary on foreign labor certification policy.

title: Move OFLC out of ETA under a politically accountable director
uncertainties: The Budget in Brief prints no publication date and does not state the reporting line; the Deputy Secretary reporting line comes from a law-firm report dated 2026-04-13. The Secretary's memorandum was not opened; its date and terms come from a law-firm article. Whether Congress has acted on the FY2027 request, which covers the fiscal year that began 2026-10-01, was not checked. A Federal Register search by the researcher found no OFLC reorganization notice.
